verdict.rationale: Capacities publishes a live llms.txt file (confirmed via direct probe returning HTTP 200 with structured documentation index) plus extensive agent-oriented docs including a dedicated MCP developer guide and REST API docs, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable documentation. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no OpenAPI spec (404s) to complement the llms.txt for deeper agent tooling.
